enunciado.br: Use o teorema de Green para calcular a circulação de F = (−y, x) na borda do retângulo 0 ≤ x ≤ 10, 0 ≤ y ≤ 10, no sentido anti-horário. (duas casas decimais)
enunciado.fr: Utilisez le théorème de Green pour calculer la circulation de F = (−y, x) sur le bord du rectangle 0 ≤ x ≤ 10, 0 ≤ y ≤ 10, dans le sens anti-horaire. (deux décimales)
enunciado.en: Use Green’s theorem to calculate the circulation of F = (−y, x) along the boundary of the rectangle 0 ≤ x ≤ 10, 0 ≤ y ≤ 10, counterclockwise. (two decimal places)
